utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there for the repair drive. Thanks for putting me on Quinn’s invite list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll pass that along. I’ll share the drop-off window as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Just let me know the drop-off window when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I dropped off the screws and tape with Rosa this afternoon, so that part’s handled. Let me know if you still need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Rosa has the screws and tape, right? And Bo and Sam are still helping with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Rosa has the screws and tape. And yes, Bo and Sam are still helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m bringing a wrench set and some spare screwdrivers to the repair drive. Bo said he’ll head over when it starts, and Uli’s coming too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Sam—thank you. I’ll be here this afternoon to log everything, and the drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll bring the tools Sunday and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll put together a quick list for you, Gus. Rey’s bringing work gloves and a hammer, and you can bring whatever tools you already have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll check the sign-up sheet first and then make sure the details get shared with both groups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Hana. I’ll keep the list handy and share it once I’ve got everyone’s details straight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive, and I’ll see what tools I can bring too. Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers, and Faye can help around school drop-off and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps a lot, Mara. I’ll keep track of who’s covering which spots and make sure the west side stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal. I’ll check what tools I can bring and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m on it — I’ll bring a few hand tools and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I can sort the donations and help load a few boxes. Sounds like we’re getting close once Vik gives the go-ahead.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it simple and bring the tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — if Hana checks the sign-up sheet first, we’ll know what’s still needed. I’ll swing by late, but I should be able to help for a bit on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive. Rey really appreciated the help too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. Let me know if you hear anything, and I’ll try to catch up late on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need more volunteers for the Saturday shifts, and Ira says tools, spare parts, and help sorting donations are still needed too. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep everyone updated on the plan for Saturday. I’ll also mention that we still need volunteers, tools, spare parts, and help sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik. Please keep me posted if you hear anything about the Saturday crowd or the drop-off window.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking we should go sooner if we can, before it gets too busy later. Do you know if there’s anything I need to drop off before the crowd builds?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t think you need to drop anything off ahead of time—just come by sooner if you can, and I’ll make sure both friend groups hear the details. I’m encouraging everyone to swing through while it’s still calm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — I’ll try to come sooner while it’s still calm. If you hear any timing changes, please let me know so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Bo’s bringing a few hand tools and gloves, and I can be there for an hour or two on Saturday to help however needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I’ll spread the word about Saturday volunteers and the tool list. I’m still listening for the drop-off window too, so I’ll let Pia know if I hear when it starts getting crowded.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m glad you’re keeping everyone updated. If you hear the drop-off window, just let me know and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s happening here right now, so I brought my work gloves and a hammer. I’ll keep in touch with Ira in case I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I can help around school drop-off or pickup if that makes it easier. Keep me posted if the schedule changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll let you know if anything shifts. Thanks for being ready to help around school drop-off or pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the drop-off window, and once Leo sends the updated details, I’ll catch up and help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll set aside a hammer and a few screwdrivers for you, Noah. I’ll also bring the tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that works for me. I’ll wait for Leo’s update and keep an eye out for the drop-off window.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll be here this afternoon to log Cleo’s screws and tape, and Rey’s gloves and hammer will be a big help too. The repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’ll help spread the word too. I’ll make sure both friend groups know to come by Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Dane — thank you. I’m glad you’ll help spread the word for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll bring a few hand tools and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll send Noah the updated details and Rosa’s got the sign-up and supply list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. I’m set on the hand tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll set aside a hammer and a few screwdrivers for Noah, and I’ll bring the tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I can be there for an hour or two on Saturday and help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Nell — an hour or two will help a lot. I’ll bring the tools Saturday and we’ll get things moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep my ears open for any repair drive news and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll make a quick list for Gus and get it over to him.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll pass along anything I hear while I’m out. Hope Gus gets that list soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Bo and Sam are both helping with the repair drive, right? And Sam’s bringing a few tools, while Rosa has the screws and tape?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that sounds right — Bo’s bringing a few hand tools and gloves, and I can help around school drop-off or pickup if that works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so Bo’s on tools and gloves, Sam’s bringing a few tools, and Rosa has the screws and tape?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I dropped off the screws and tape with Rosa this afternoon. Vik’s been keeping everyone posted on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to know—thanks. If it’s already moving fast, I should probably drop off anything else sooner rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please do—Rosa’s keeping it organized, so the sooner the better. If you have anything else, I’d bring it by today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there for the repair drive. And please keep me on Quinn’s invite list too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep you on Quinn’s invite list, and thanks for helping keep an eye out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate it — I’ll be there and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Bo, Sam, and Uli are on the invite list, and Mara said she’ll see what tools she can bring. I’m still gathering everyone for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ve got Sam on the west side of the repair tent checking for loose boxes, and Mara’s helping spread the word with whatever tools she can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, that helps a lot — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure Bo and Uli know where to head. Thanks for covering the west side!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need more volunteers for the Saturday shifts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll let both groups know and share the details so they can come by. Hopefully we can get those Saturday shifts filled!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. If you can, please also point people to the tools-and-parts list so we cover everything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check what tools I can bring for the repair drive, and I’ll spread the word too. Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I’ll keep listening for the drop-off window and whether it’s getting crowded. If I hear anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an eye out for any tool updates on my side too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s here now, so I’m bringing my work gloves and hammer. If you hear anything, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the drop-off window and pass along anything Leo sends. Once I get the updated details, I’ll help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah. I’ll be ready here with my gloves and hammer when it’s time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the sign-up sheet first before I do anything else. Then I can help keep everyone in the loop about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — I can sort the donations and load a few boxes when you’re ready. Just let me know when the drive moves ahead.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps a lot, Oren. I’ll confirm the sheet first, and then I’ll let you know when it’s time to move the drive ahead.
